label: Finding-6
title: quarkslab-2024: 'Two parties agree' is one origin, and 'confirmed' is overstated
description: Calif writes 'We were able to confirm from PHP a similar/related issue was uncovered but exploitation was not proven in 2024', so its account derives from PHP. The causal 'so it was not fixed' is Calif's; the Foundation says the fix stalled because of competing approaches, consensus decision-making and a lack of resources. Status should be 'reported', with the Foundation's version as the lead.
